chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥajjāl, from Thaʿlabah, from Zurārah, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar and Abū ʿAbdillāh, peace be upon them, saying:
Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, delegated to His Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, the affair of His creation so that He may observe how their obedience would be.
Then he recited this verse: “Whatever the Messenger gives you, take it; and whatever he forbids you from, refrain.”

key_terms.أَمْرَ خَلْقِهِ: the affair of His creation; their governing matter
key_terms.الرَّسُولُ: the Messenger whose commands are to be followed
key_terms.فَانْتَهُوا: refrain; desist from what is prohibited
key_terms.فَخُذُوهُ: take it; accept and adhere to it
key_terms.نَبِيِّهِ: His Prophet, meaning the divinely appointed messenger

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith show that obedience to the Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله is divinely mandated?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, entrusted His Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله with authority over the affair of the creation as a test of their obedience. It supports this meaning by citing the Quranic command to accept what the Messenger gives and refrain from what he forbids, showing the binding authority of the Prophet’s command.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hajjal, from Sa’alba, from Zurara who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> both saying:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Authorised to His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and the affairs of His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures in order to See how their obedience would be’.
Then heasws recited this Verse [59:7] and whatever the Rasool gives you, accept it, and from whatever he forbids you, keep back’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hajjal from Tha‘labah that Zurarah who has said
that he heard abu Ja‘far and abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say
the following. “Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High has made the Holy Prophet in charge of the affairs of His creatures to see how their obedience is.
He then recited this verse of Holy Quran, “. .what the Messenger (of Allah) you, you must take (obey) and what he prohibits you, you must desist from. .” [59:7]
